notes.title: Game Release Special 15% Off!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of "Unknown Memoirs of 'The Rental", an episodic psychological horror game that will send shivers down your spine. Prepare yourself for a bone-chilling experience as you navigate a dilapidated rental apartment, uncovering the dark secrets that lie hidden within. And the best part? We're offering a special 15% discount for a limited time to celebrate the game's launch!

In this atmospheric short story horror game, players will find themselves in a world where something sinister lurks behind every corner. From the moment you step foot into your new home, you'll realize that all is not well. Eerie echoes of strange noises pierce the stillness of the night, objects mysteriously move on their own accord, and haunting visions torment your dreams.

As the protagonist, you must unravel the mysteries that shroud this crumbling building and the twisted minds of your neighbours. Prepare to explore every nook and cranny of the apartment complex, for it is within these walls that the dark secrets await your discovery. Brace yourself as you delve deeper into the abyss, peeling back the layers of the building's violent and bloody history. But beware, something malevolent still lingers, watching your every move.

"Unknown Memoirs of 'The Rental'" offers a unique gameplay experience within the "Walking Simulator" genre. With its focus on realism, the game immerses players in a hauntingly realistic world, where the line between reality and nightmares blurs.

Don't miss out on this bone-chilling adventure! For a limited time, you can get "Unknown Memoirs : The Rental'" at a 15% discounted price. Embrace the fear, uncover the truth, and face the horrors that await you in this psychological journey into darkness.
